STATES.NO_ACCESS: You are not part of any CRM business unit yet. Ask an administrator to add you.
STATES.NO_PIPELINES: There is no pipeline in your business units yet. An administrator or manager needs to create one in Settings > Pipelines.

FILTERS.SEARCH: Search by deal, contact or phone

UNITS.TITLE: Business units
UNITS.DESCRIPTION: Companies or brands of the group. Only members of a unit see its deals. Sellers edit their own deals; managers edit all of them and configure pipelines.
UNITS.EMPTY: No units yet. Start by creating the companies of the group.
UNITS.NAME: Name
UNITS.NO_MEMBERS: No agents in this unit yet.

PIPELINES.TITLE: Pipelines and stages
PIPELINES.DESCRIPTION: Each unit can have several pipelines. Won and lost stages close the deal automatically.
PIPELINES.NAME: Pipeline name
PIPELINES.STAGES_HELP: This order is the column order on the Kanban. At least one open stage is required. A stage with deals can't be removed.

REASONS.TITLE: Lost and forwarding reasons
REASONS.DESCRIPTION: Once a lost reason exists, marking a deal as lost requires picking one.
REASONS.IN_USE: This reason was already used. Deactivate it instead.

FIELDS.TITLE: Custom fields
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION: Extra deal information, like tax ID, segment or fleet size. Deactivating hides the field without deleting saved values.
FIELDS.LABEL: Field name

GENERAL.TITLE: General
GENERAL.DESCRIPTION: Rules for the whole CRM of this account.
GENERAL.MAX_ATTEMPTS_HELP: How many times the same lead can be forwarded between units before the journey closes (used by forwarding).

AUTOMATIONS.TITLE: Ready-made automations
AUTOMATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Actions the CRM takes on its own. All start turned off and each one is recorded on the opportunity timeline. Nothing is sent to the customer.
AUTOMATIONS.LABELS_TITLE: Label on the conversation when the opportunity closes
AUTOMATIONS.LABEL_HELP: Applies to opportunities with a linked conversation. The label is added as Automation System, like Chatwoot automations.
AUTOMATIONS.CLOSE_TASKS: Complete pending tasks when won or lost
AUTOMATIONS.CLOSE_TASKS_HELP: Open tasks of the opportunity are completed by the system.
AUTOMATIONS.STALLED_TASK: Create a task when the opportunity stalls in the same stage
AUTOMATIONS.STALLED_HELP: The follow-up task goes to the owner, once per stage visit. A stage with its own deadline uses that deadline. The check runs every hour.
AUTOMATIONS.CHECKED: Check done. Stalled-opportunity tasks: {count}. Rules that ran: {rules}
AUTOMATIONS.HIGHLIGHT_NO_TASK: Highlight opportunities with no next task
AUTOMATIONS.HIGHLIGHT_NO_TASK_HELP: On the board and in the table, an open opportunity with no pending task shows "No next task". To chase the seller, create a "No next task" rule.

RULES.TITLE: Rules: when this happens, do that
RULES.DESCRIPTION: Build rules like "when the opportunity enters the Proposal stage, create these tasks". They run as System, are recorded on the opportunity timeline and never send anything to the customer.
RULES.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The rule "{name}" stops running. What it already did stays on the timeline.
RULES.EMPTY: No rules yet. Click New rule and start from a template.
RULES.NAME: Rule name

TRIGGERS.STALLED: Opportunity stalled in the same stage

TRIGGER_HELP.CREATED: Applies to every new opportunity, including one forwarded from another unit.
TRIGGER_HELP.STAGE_ENTERED: Pick the stage below to create its template tasks. With no stage, it runs on every stage change. A new opportunity counts as entering the first stage.
TRIGGER_HELP.WON: Runs right after the ready-made win automations.
TRIGGER_HELP.LOST: Runs right after the built-in lost automations. Here you can filter by lost reason and forward the deal to another unit.
TRIGGER_HELP.STALLED: Checked every hour. Runs once per stage visit.
TRIGGER_HELP.NO_NEXT_TASK: Checked every hour, counting from the last completed task (or from creation). Runs again only after the opportunity completes another task.

RULES.ACTIONS_HELP: Up to 5 actions per rule. No action changes the deal stage. "Forward" runs last and the new deal in the destination can trigger the "Deal created" rules there.
RULES.SET_OWNER_HELP: Only changes when the person belongs to the unit or is an administrator; otherwise the timeline says so.
RULES.LABEL_HELP: Applies to opportunities with a linked conversation. The label is added as Automation System.
RULES.NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: Note text added to the opportunity timeline

PRESETS.TITLE: Start from a template
PRESETS.NEW_DEAL: First contact on a new opportunity
PRESETS.STALLED_MANAGERS_TASK: Review the stalled opportunity with the seller
PRESETS.NEXT_TASK_TASK: Define the next step of the opportunity
PRESETS.LOST_FORWARD: Forward lost deals to another unit

ERRORS.NAME: Give the rule a name (up to 80 characters).
ERRORS.WAIT: The waiting time goes from 1 hour to 90 days.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY: The account reached the limit of 30 rules.
ERRORS.CONDITIONS: The chosen unit, pipeline or stage no longer exists.
ERRORS.TASK_DUE: the due time goes from 0 to 90 days.
ERRORS.USER: choose a person from the account.
ERRORS.LABEL: choose an existing label.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_FORWARDS: Use only one forward per rule.
ERRORS.FORWARD_TRIGGER: Forwarding only works on “when the deal is lost”.
ERRORS.FORWARD_PIPELINE: the pipeline must belong to the destination unit.
ERRORS.FORWARD_REASON: choose a forwarding reason from the list.
ERRORS.FORWARD_OWNER: the owner must belong to the destination unit.

FORWARD.CREATE_TASK: Create the “Contact the customer” task for the owner (due in 30 minutes)
FORWARD.HELP: The lost deal becomes forwarded and a new deal opens in the destination unit, in the first stage, with the same contact, conversation, value and fields. It does not forward if the contact already has an open deal there or the journey reached the forwarding limit; the timeline shows why.
